claims: Adesanya vs. Pyfer takes place on Saturday, March 28, 2026.
Adesanya vs. Pyfer takes place at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle.
Adesanya vs. Pyfer features a middleweight main event between former champion Israel Adesanya and Joe Pyfer.
UFC Seattle Main Card begins at 8 p.m. ET.
UFC Seattle Main Card streams on Paramount+.
UFC Seattle Preliminary Card begins at 5 p.m. ET.
UFC Seattle Preliminary Card streams on Paramount+.
UFC Seattle Main Card includes a middleweight bout between Joe Pyfer and Israel Adesanya.
Alexa Grasso vs. Maycee Barber is the co-main event.
UFC Seattle Main Card includes a women’s flyweight bout between Alexa Grasso and Maycee Barber.
UFC Seattle Main Card includes a welterweight bout between Michael Chiesa and Niko Price.
UFC Seattle Main Card includes a featherweight bout between Julian Erosa and Lerryan Douglas.
UFC Seattle Main Card includes a middleweight bout between Yousri Belgaroui and Mansur Abdul-Malik.
UFC Seattle Main Card includes a lightweight bout between Terrance McKinney and Kyle Nelson.
UFC Seattle Preliminary Card includes a lightweight bout between Tofiq Musayev and Ignacio Bahamondes.
UFC Seattle Preliminary Card includes a lightweight bout between Lance Gibson Jr. and Chase Hooper.
UFC Seattle Preliminary Card includes a heavyweight bout between Tyrell Fortune and Marcin Tybura.
UFC Seattle Preliminary Card includes a women’s flyweight bout between Casey O’Neill and Gabriella Fernandes.
UFC Seattle Preliminary Card includes a light heavyweight bout between Navajo Stirling and Bruno Lopes.
